verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a policy layer. Funds carry restrictions on amount, interval, merchant categories, merchants, and countries (ramp-docs-41, spend-controls). Limits are enforced and risky categories blocked before spend happens (ramp-docs-9). Approval workflows route by spend amount or team role across cards, reimbursements, and bills (ramp-docs-12, ramp-docs-23). In-policy expenses are explicitly auto-approved, while unclear or risky ones escalate to a human (ramp-docs-32, ramp-supp-ramp-agents-product, ramp-docs-10). missing for 10: detailed configuration docs for role-based limit rules and auto-approval thresholds (most evidence is marketing copy), independent or hands-on corroboration.
